headline: Frontlines Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the war’s heaviest fighting remains concentrated in a half‑dozen corridors. Callahans Passage added roughly 11 000 Colonial and 12 000 Warden dead in the past day and recorded 29 ownership changes, the most recent moments ago. Weathered Expanse follows with about 8 200 Colonial and 12 100 Warden casualties and 27 flips, the latest minutes ago. Nevish Line logged 6 300 Colonial and 6 700 Warden losses with 39 base exchanges, while Palantine Berm saw 1 000‑plus casualties each side and 36 flips, though its short‑term casualty rates have begun to cool. Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand each reported 22 and 14 events respectively, with casualty rates accelerating on both fronts. Hourly casualty rates are rising on Callahans, Weathered, Nevish, Stlican and Kuura; enlistments are climbing on Palantine, Kuura and Stlican but falling elsewhere. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
